CustomField.label: Loan still open
CustomField.description: SCRUM-468 round 4 (AC5, PO decision (b)): true while the loan has no return date. Drives the filter of the ListView SCRUM468_Open_Loans; no automation reads it. House shape: SCRUM468_Overdue filters on the formula Checkbox Overdue_Today__c (measured live, 2 rows).
